# CorpusMap reading companion

> Unofficial guide to Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search, arXiv:2609.37226v1, by Soyeong Jeong, Sujay Kumar Jauhar, Sung Ju Hwang, and Andrew Joohun Nam. Original notes; no implementation or reproduced experiments.

## Entry points

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): evidence and routing rules.
- [README](README.md): overview, qualified headline evidence, and human navigation.
- [Machine-readable metadata](metadata.json): exact source version, author attribution, and scope.
- [Reading map](docs/reading-map.md): source section/page index.

## Detailed notes

- [Method](docs/method.md): construction and navigation.
- [Notation](docs/notation.md): formal objects and glossary.
- [Evaluation](docs/evaluation.md): selected datasets, baselines, metrics, and protocol.
- [Results](docs/results.md): numerical evidence and ablations with qualifications.
- [Visual guide](docs/visual-guide.md): figure/table reading and locators.
- [Limitations](docs/limitations.md): paper cautions and companion questions.
- [Reproduction](docs/reproduction.md): prerequisites for a future independent reproduction.

## Provenance

- [Sources](SOURCES.md): source access, version verification, license and project-link status.
- [Notice](NOTICE.md): attribution and material exclusions.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): preferred paper citation.
- [BibTeX](references/paper.bib): v1 citation.
